context: The agent runs the structural-reasoning half of a page reduction on a synthetic Phase 1 output for a fictional coffee shop (9 sections, index 0 to 8). The tokenizedHtml of all sections totals 7,774 bytes. Sections 5 (carousel arrows and dots, only {ICON} tokens) and 6 (an empty counter) have no content tokens; section 8 is a cookie consent dialog with no {INPUT} or {SELECT}. Judge skeleton.html and manifest.json.

checklist.name: two_siblings_kept
checklist.description: Section 2 (promo-pair) keeps both promo tiles written out. Two identical siblings are not collapsed: no `{REPEAT:1}` or other `{REPEAT}` token in this section.

checklist.name: different_cards_not_merged
checklist.description: Section 3 keeps all three feature cards, which differ in their tokens (image and CTA; video and two texts; icon, list and link). They are not merged into one card with a `{REPEAT}` token.

checklist.name: identical_cards_collapsed
checklist.description: Section 4 (product carousel, six identical product cards) keeps two cards followed by `{REPEAT:4}`.

checklist.name: nav_count_is_items_replaced
checklist.description: The header navigation (section 0, eight links) keeps its first two links (Coffee, Equipment) and then `{NAV:6-items}`; the footer Shop list (section 7, nine links) keeps two links and then `{NAV:7-items}`. N counts the links replaced, not the total. The four-link Company list is left whole.

checklist.name: consent_overlay_removed
checklist.description: The cookie consent dialog (section 8) does not appear in skeleton.html, and no `{FORM:0-fields}` token appears anywhere.

checklist.name: empty_sections_dropped
checklist.description: skeleton.html has no section for indexes 5 and 6. manifest.json lists `droppedSections` with 5, 6 and 8 and no other index; its `sections` and the skeleton's section comments are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7, with their Phase 1 indexes (not renumbered).

checklist.name: modifier_classes_stripped
checklist.description: State classes (`is-active`, `is-visible`, `is-sticky`), design-system modifiers (`ui-button--primary`, `ui-card--elevated`, `hero--dark`) and the generated class `_track_3fa9c_21` are removed, while classes that name the element (hero, promo-tile, feature-card, product-card, footer-nav…) and the options `three-up` and `compact` on the feature-cards block (section 3, `data-block-name="feature-cards"`) are kept.

checklist.name: skeleton_not_larger
checklist.description: Without its `<!-- section:… -->` comment lines, skeleton.html is no larger than the Phase 1 tokenizedHtml it came from: at most 7,774 bytes.
